overview_description.description: Turion Space develops and operates spacecraft and software systems designed to support space domain awareness, in-orbit operations, and satellite servicing. The company builds integrated platforms that combine satellites, propulsion systems, and software to enable tasks such as monitoring space objects, gathering orbital data, and performing rendezvous or maintenance missions. Its DROID satellite fleet is designed for mobility and interaction in orbit, including debris mitigation and servicing of existing satellites to extend their operational lifespan. The company also provides software systems, such as its Starfire platform, which support mission planning, autonomous tasking, and command and control of satellite constellations. Its approach emphasizes in-house development of mission components and integration of hardware and software to support both government and commercial space operations.

product.name: DROID Satellites
product.description: High-performance satellites designed for commercial, defense, and government missions, offering maneuverability and long-term operational efficiency in low Earth orbit and deep space.

product.name: Turion Ion Engine (TIE-20)
product.description: A krypton-optimized gridded ion thruster providing efficient, precise orbital maneuvers and extended mission duration for satellites in low Earth orbit and beyond.

product.name: StarfireOS™
product.description: An advanced spacecraft operating system providing real-time management of satellite operations, mission planning, and fleet coordination with AI-driven automation.

product.name: Starfire NEXUS
product.description: A cloud-based platform enabling customers to deploy and test their own software on Turion DROID satellites for rapid on-orbit validation and R&D.
